title: "iMOD Python 1.1.0"
description: "iMOD Python 1.1.0 is released 🎂"
author: "Joeri van Engelen"
date: "2026-08-10"
image: ../figures/logo/iMOD-python.svg
---

We are happy to announce the release of iMOD Python 1.1.0 🎉. The focus of this
release was to improve the functionality to work with existing iMOD5 models, in
collaboration with the "Kernteam Transitie NHI" 🤝.

🛠️ This release fixes over 20 bugs and contains new improvements 🛠️, including:

- Directly regridding iMOD5 databases into MODFLOW 6 simulations with the new
  ``target_grid`` argument in
  [``imod.mf6.Modflow6Simulation.from_imod5_data()``](https://deltares.github.io/imod-python/api/generated/mf6/imod.mf6.Modflow6Simulation.from_imod5_data.html).
- Added
  [imod.mf6.HorizontalFlowBarrierResistance.from_imod5_data()](https://deltares.github.io/imod-python/api/generated/mf6/imod.mf6.HorizontalFlowBarrierResistance.from_imod5_data.html)
  to load barriers from 3D GEN files.
- Added ``ignore_time_purge_empty`` argument to
  [imod.mf6.Modflow6Simulation.mask_all_models()](https://deltares.github.io/imod-python/api/generated/mf6/imod.mf6.Modflow6Simulation.mask_all_models.html)
  and
  [imod.mf6.Modflow6Simulation.clip_box()](https://deltares.github.io/imod-python/api/generated/mf6/imod.mf6.Modflow6Simulation.clip_box.html)
  to consider a package empty if its first time step is all nodata. This can
  increase performance a lot when working with models with many timesteps.

For the NHI collaboration, we furthermore developed a tool to help with the
transition from iMOD5 to MODFLOW 6, which has a similar interface as iMOD5's
iMOD BATCH "RUNFILE" function. [It can be found here and is a useful aid to
transition from an iMOD5 model to iMOD Python.](https://github.com/Deltares/iMOD-Suite-transition-regional-models)

This doesn't end the work with the NHI collaboration, as we are still working on
implementing some remaining iMOD5 features, like the sprinkling from IPF files.
But since so many things have been fixed and improved, we decided to release
this version now.

Find out how to install iMOD Python 1.1.0 in the [installation
instructions](https://deltares.github.io/imod-python/installation.html).
